capabilities: Supplies a Templater syntax guide to the Verbex agent
Covers tp.date, tp.file, tp.system, tp.frontmatter and tp.obsidian modules
Declares Templater as a required dependency
Shows bridge and Templater status in a settings tab
Ships the guide in English and Korean
disambiguation: Not a template runner or Templater extension; it only supplies a reference guide to the Verbex agent and never executes templates.
extras: Skill-only provider for the agentinterop protocol (v1) with no commands, editor features or network access; shows one notice per session when an older Verbex is enabled. Skill data is generated from agent-skills/ by the Verbex generator.
problem: The Verbex agent has no built-in reference for Templater's template syntax and tp.* modules, so it cannot help write templates.

relations.evidence: gives the Verbex AI agent a guide to Templater templates and tp.* syntax
Templater (templater-obsidian) enabled. The Skill declares it as required

summary: Skill-only provider that gives the Verbex AI agent a guide to Templater templates and tp.* syntax.
